import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and cnt[g[i][0]]==w]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and cnt[g[0][j]]==h]
    row_bounds=[]; prev=0
    for i in sorted(sep_rows)+[h]:
        if i>prev: row_bounds.append((prev,i))
        prev=i+1
    col_bounds=[]; prev=0
    for j in sorted(sep_cols)+[w]:
        if j>prev: col_bounds.append((prev,j))
        prev=j+1
    regions=[(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in row_bounds for c0,c1 in col_bounds]
    def uniform(r):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=r
        return len({g[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1)})==1
    blocks=[r for r in regions if not uniform(r)]
    print(regions, blocks)
    assert len(blocks)==1
    b0=blocks[0]; br0,br1,bc0,bc1=b0
    src=[[g[i][j] for j in range(bc0,bc1)] for i in range(br0,br1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    bh,bw=len(src),len(src[0])
    for r in regions:
        if r==b0: continue
        r0,r1,c0,c1=r
        for i in range(r0,r1):
            for j in range(c0,c1):
                out[i][j]=src[(i-r0)%bh][(j-c0)%bw]
    return out
